remarks: Beautifully updated first-floor apartment in the heart of Greenwich. Offering 2 spacious bedrooms with generous closet space and a large full bath, this charming home blends comfort, convenience, and style. Bright open-concept living and dining area flows into an updated kitchen featuring a dishwasher and a walk-in pantry, creating an inviting space for both everyday living and entertaining.  Freshly painted with new flooring throughout, this move-in-ready home also offers in-unit convenience with access to a washer and dryer in the basement and a dedicated storage room. Step outside to enjoy the beautifully finished bluestone patio and shared backyard-perfect for relaxing or enjoying the outdoors , grill etc!!   Laundry is located in the basement of the neighboring house (same owner). Coin-operated laundry. Off-street parking spaces available.
